name: Can I live in my home during a major remodeling project?

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my home during a major remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can live in your home during a major remodel depends on the project's scope, especially if it involves essential areas like the kitchen or bathrooms, or if there are significant structural changes. It can be disruptive due to noise, dust, and temporary utility interruptions. Discussing logistics and potential alternative living arrangements with your contractor early on is crucial. For some projects, living off-site can speed up the process and reduce stress.
acceptedAnswer.description: Living in your home during a major remodel depends on the project's scope; it can be disruptive. Discuss logistics with your contractor and consider temporary alternative living.
